chapter: St. Cyr, Dreamland and the OK festival
title: How she met Johnny St. Cyr and his job with Doc Cook at the Dreamland
summary: A foster sister knew St. Cyr, who urged her to use her voice; at the time he played at the Dreamland with Doc Cook.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh, yes. It was one of the things that I wondered about. How did you happen to get to know Johnny? Did you say just he heard you singing around the house? How did I get to know him? Yeah.

Well, I had met him. You know, he was a... My foster sister knew him, and he came to see her, you know. And she... He was... I was introduced to him. And of course I was singing and singing around the house. And he says, uh... Lily, say, my goodness. You say you have an awful good voice. Why don't you do something with that voice? I said, well, why don't you help me do something with it? He said, well, I will. I'll see what I can do. Because at that time he was playing at Harman's, uh... Yeah.
The Dreamland, maybe? Yeah. The Dreamland Ballroom.

Mm-hmm. And... Do you remember whom he was playing with? Would that have been Doc Cook or Doc Cook? That's right. Because I remember him saying so. Well, you see, that also connects with Jimmy Noon, who was playing over there, too, with Doc Cook.
Yeah, I remember him saying he was playing with Cook. I remember that.
